triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Mitya remembered Andrey again, and ordered punch to be sent out to him. “I was rude to him just now,” he repeated with a sinking, softened voice.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: She was ashamed, and from her eyes he could see now whom she loved. Now he had everything to make life happy

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: Mitya, Mitya, how could I be such a fool as to think I could love any one after you? Do you forgive me, Mitya? Do you forgive me or not? Do you love me? Do you love me?

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He jumped up and ran back to the room—to her, to her, his queen for ever! Was not one moment of her love worth all the rest of life, even in the agonies of disgrace?

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: You will forgive me for having tormented you? It was through spite I tormented you all. It was for spite I drove the old man out of his mind....

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: “Leave off laughing at Poland,” said Kalganov sententiously.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov, it is my duty to inform you that you are charged with the murder of your father, Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, perpetrated this night....

triples.subject: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov
triples.quote: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov, it is my duty to inform you that you are charged with the murder of your father, Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, perpetrated this night....

triples.subject: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov
triples.quote: I love you. I love only you. I’ll love you in Siberia....

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: I was with some one I loved, with you. And far, far away. I was holding you and kissing you, nestling close to you.

triples.subject: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov
triples.quote: Grusha, you wanted to be honest, but I’m a thief. But I’ve stolen money from Katya.... Disgrace, a disgrace!
